expectations.text: States the mechanism: a cross-border transfer impact assessment (CPDTIA/CTIA) dossier submitted to A05/MPS within 60 days of first transfer (per Decree 356/2025)
expectations.evidence: TIA dossier and MPS filing mentioned but attributed to "Decree 13 originally set a 60-day post-transfer filing" with PDPL requirements framed as "later drafts"; no Decree 356/2025

expectations.text: Mentions ongoing duties: periodic updates (6-monthly) and updates on material changes
expectations.evidence: Only "keep the TIA dossier updated if the nature, volume, or recipient of the transfer changes"; no 6-monthly periodic update duty

expectations.text: States the enforcement risk under Decree 330/2026: concealment/misdeclaration or assessment failures combined with breach/loss of citizens' data trigger the revenue-based fine bands (up to 3–5% of Vietnam-market revenue)
expectations.evidence: Hedged "potential revenue-based fines (reportedly up to ~5% of Vietnam-derived revenue)"; no Decree 330, no concealment/misdeclaration-plus-breach trigger, no bands

expectations.text: Distinguishes the lesser offence: plain failure to file/update the dossier carries fixed fines around VND 30–50M
expectations.evidence: States "fines... from roughly 100 million to 500 million VND per violation"; does not identify the VND 30–50M fixed fine for plain failure to file/update

expectations.text: Notes suspension of cross-border transfers as an available remedial measure
expectations.evidence: "Regulators can also order suspension of the transfer"
